text_block_list.text:
During the second overseas training.
It happened during free time――!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? For real?
Oh no~! Our transportation just vanished!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: No way~! In that case――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's just walk! I totally wanted
to explore around here more anyway~♪

Those words reminded me of the first day of overseas training.
Back then, did fretting over things ever solve anything?
Times like this are precisely when...
choice_data_list: That sounds great! Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're up for it? Then let's go together!

And so, we ended up strolling around with Vivlos
while heading toward the hotel we were staying at.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Over here, over here~!
I totally wanted to look at souvenirs~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I already bought presents for my big sisters,
so this time it's for myself!
choice_data_list: Sounds great, I'll pick something out too!
Sounds great, I'll pick something out too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, there are tons of ship motifs, aren't there?
Is it because we're close to the sea?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's because sightseeing boats depart from here.
They're the symbol of this town."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah~! It's like a luxury cruise liner!
Where can you go sightseeing? I'm so curious~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, we scored some transportation~!
choice_data_list: We can cross to the opposite shore with this!
We can cross to the opposite shore with this!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Plu-u-us, we can even eat while gazing at the ocean!
That's, like, totally celebrity-style~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's live music too~,
we're gonna have such a wonderful time~!

text_block_list.name: Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
"Please take your time and enjoy yourselves.
You might even spot dolphins around these waters."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!!!!!
I wanna see dolphins!!
choice_data_list: Isn't that one between those waves?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, where, where!?
Wait, gotta take a photo, a photo!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Phew~! Ahh, that was so fun!
We got souvenirs~, and took a boat trip!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And we even found a cafe that wasn't listed in any guidebook!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Having the subway stop might've actually been a good thing~!
choice_data_list: It's all in how you look at it!
It's all in how you look at it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I mean,
most things work out in the end anyway, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I think it's way more rewarding to stay positive~!

...Even if that's true,
in reality, doing so is usually quite difficult.

If I had just stayed there brooding back then,
obsessed only with getting back,
I never would have enjoyed myself this much.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
No way, not at a-a-all!
I had so much fun too~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I might've been the one who invited you,
but Trainer-san was the one who went along with it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And with that! To this wonderful day~...
Cheers!
